research_rationale: Read the embedded official original, held actor contexts, own terms, chain, conflicts and missing notices. Corrected the inventory using exact original-source spans. No machine search is accepted while the material current-law conflict remains unresolved. EO14173 section 3(b)(i) hereby revokes EO11246 on 2025-01-21; the full actor context contains no postponed revocation date. The optional 90-day contractor compliance allowance is a transitional residual, not a delay of express revocation. Section 3(b)(ii) immediately ends OFCCP affirmative-action enforcement. EO11375 replaces original sections 101, 104, 202(1)/(2), 203(d). Part I is effective 30 days after 1967-10-13 (candidate 1967-11-12); Part II one year after (candidate 1968-10-13). Actual page verification is required before confirming these dates. EO12086 sections 1-201 through 1-214 change administration/enforcement and numerous original provisions. Section 1-302 defaults conforming amendments to 1978-10-08 but excepts section 1-101 agencies, whose effective dates follow OMB transfer determinations under section 1-301 within 60 days. Signing date 1978-10-05 does not determine those dates. EO13279 section 4 replaces section 204 exemption provisions. EO13665 renumbers original section 202(3)-(7) and adds a compensation-disclosure clause. EO13672 alters section 202(1)/(2) and 203(d). Both 2014 orders are immediately effective but apply contract amendments to contracts made on/after implementing-rule effective dates; those rule dates are not held here. Original section 405 delays activation 30 days and is not a sunset. Original section 403(a) abolishes a committee and transfers records/property; section 403(b) independently preserves prior obligations/directives until revocation or supersession. The 2025 revocation does not demonstrate reversal of completed transfers or extinguishment of accrued obligations.

findings: EO14173 section 3(b)(i) hereby revokes EO11246 on 2025-01-21; the full actor context contains no postponed revocation date. The optional 90-day contractor compliance allowance is a transitional residual, not a delay of express revocation. Section 3(b)(ii) immediately ends OFCCP affirmative-action enforcement.

EO11375 replaces original sections 101, 104, 202(1)/(2), 203(d). Part I is effective 30 days after 1967-10-13 (candidate 1967-11-12); Part II one year after (candidate 1968-10-13). Actual page verification is required before confirming these dates.

EO12086 sections 1-201 through 1-214 change administration/enforcement and numerous original provisions. Section 1-302 defaults conforming amendments to 1978-10-08 but excepts section 1-101 agencies, whose effective dates follow OMB transfer determinations under section 1-301 within 60 days. Signing date 1978-10-05 does not determine those dates.

EO13279 section 4 replaces section 204 exemption provisions. EO13665 renumbers original section 202(3)-(7) and adds a compensation-disclosure clause. EO13672 alters section 202(1)/(2) and 203(d). Both 2014 orders are immediately effective but apply contract amendments to contracts made on/after implementing-rule effective dates; those rule dates are not held here.

Original section 405 delays activation 30 days and is not a sunset. Original section 403(a) abolishes a committee and transfers records/property; section 403(b) independently preserves prior obligations/directives until revocation or supersession. The 2025 revocation does not demonstrate reversal of completed transfers or extinguishment of accrued obligations.
